text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The new year arrived, and I went on the first shrine visit of the year at Tokai Teio's invitation.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa... what a massive crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If this many people pray all at once,
God's gonna have His hands full just listening to them all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's line up quick!
If we don't hurry, even the gods might close for the day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Shrine visit complete!
Phew~ Feels like a job well done!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for tagging along, Trainer!
Man, I really didn't expect it to be this crowded.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I thought about coming with the Pre-z, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about what to wish to the gods,
I felt like I had to do it together with you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: What did you make a wish for?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I wrote, 'May I surpass the President!'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm finally in the Senior Class,
I feel like the Prez's back is finally in sight!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll take on tons of big races and prove I can become the number one Umamusume someday!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what did you wish for?
You seemed to be praying really seriously.
choice_data_list: How about "I will look after Teio's health"?
How about "I will strive to improve Teio's abilities"?
How about "I will help Teio upgrade her skills"?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
You were worried about me!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll help out alongside the gods!
After last year, I realized how important health really is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No pushing too hard, and plenty of rest!
I'll do my best, so keep an eye on me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Improving my skills...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, when you say stuff like that,
it just makes me wanna try even harder, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, Lady Teio
shall grant her Trainer's wish~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Skill up...?
Does that mean getting better at what I'm already good at?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer thinks that's what
I need right now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it!
I'll keep that in mind myself!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, your 'request', Trainer,
sounds more like an oath, doesn't it?"
choice_data_list: First and foremost, effort is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see, just asking for favors might make
the gods mad at me for being lazy...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll rephrase mine to "Watch over me
because I'm going to surpass the President!" too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's line up one more time!
Come on, come on, hurry, hurry~!
